note: Starting points for the Environment section. Each preset selects sources and bounded overrides validated by disturbance_parameters.validate_settings; sources a preset does not list keep the repository defaults. Wind vectors are world XYZ (Z up), noise is one standard deviation in observation units, COM bounds are metres in body FRD.

presets.name: Calm
presets.summary: No wind, ideal sensors, nominal mass properties.

presets.name: Light breeze
presets.summary: 2 m/s steady wind with occasional 1.5 m/s gusts.

presets.name: Moderate wind
presets.summary: 4 m/s diagonal wind, 3 m/s gusts every 5-12 s.

presets.name: Gusty crosswind
presets.summary: 6 m/s crosswind along -Y with frequent 5 m/s gusts.

presets.name: Noisy sensors
presets.summary: Twice the repository observation noise on every channel.

presets.name: COM offset 1 cm
presets.summary: Centre of mass sampled within +/-10 mm on each body axis.

presets.name: Combined stress
presets.summary: 4 m/s wind with 4 m/s gusts, 2x sensor noise and a 1 cm COM box.
